check1_followup: Every critical and high finding from check 1 has been addressed in the text: inflow freeze enforced through reconciliation 5 with A17 and A37 as dependencies and end-to-end pass criteria; J21 path now runs distressed -> legal_hold -> exit_approved; exit-run exemption from the hold (reconciliation 7); reference-counted chain mirror with platform fan-out; board 24 h clock in every phase; Emergency pause re-pointed to A28 and A66/A72; A43, A45, A23, A104 added. Medium items are also addressed: oracle yes, actor sets recorded, G22 criterion made checkable at the gate, extension limit measured from the decision time, halts closed at wound_down, estimate 12-16, pause_tokens added. The findings below are new problems: most come from checking the spec against neighbour specs (A14, A28, A34, A36, A19, A10, A12) as they now stand.

findings.issue: The burn step contradicts A28. A28 requires the wind-down burn to be a single `burn_final` op. Its units must equal total supply, its approval is TOKO -> CFO `4E+Q` plus the 3-of-5 V1 owner quorum, it needs SM-06 `redeeming`, and it is requested only by A48. Any ordinary `burn` that would take supply to zero is refused with `TOP_BURN_NOT_FULL_SUPPLY`, and `burn` needs a token that is `active` or `redeeming`. A48 prepares one ordinary `burn` per holder under A28's `4E+Q` burn row, so the last op is always refused. J21 step 6 therefore cannot complete. The G13 list also leaves out the owner quorum, and nothing covers a token that is still `paused` from the crisis.
findings.fix: Rewrite §4 Burn to request one A28 `burn_final` (units = totalSupply, with the per-holder breakdown from A18's cap table checked first by `WD_BURN_SUM_MISMATCH`) under A28's `burn_final` row (TOKO -> CFO `4E+Q` plus the V1 3-of-5 owner quorum, maker excluded). State who moves SM-06 `active -> redeeming` according to A28, and require an `unpause` (`6E+Q`) before the burn if the token is paused. Update G13 in Requirements covered, the 'burn that is not the supply' challenge and the J21 pass criterion.

findings.issue: The P1 exit track and the SM-03 action ids conflict with A34. A34 already owns row 20 `operating -> exit_proposed`: its own route `POST .../exit/propose` for ASTM or LEGL, no approval, with a trustee resolution filed through `POST .../exit/resolution`. Rows 21 and 22 are driven by the properties SVCA once LEGL records the outcome in P1, or by A93 in P2. On A34's internal route the A48 SVCA may run only row 25 (`sold -> wound_down`); any other pair gets 403 `PROP_INTERNAL_TRIGGER_NOT_ALLOWED`. A48 defines its own `property.propose_exit` (4E), `property.approve_exit` (6E) and `property.withdraw_exit` and runs them through that route, which is none of the seven reconciliations. The spec also names A34's rows `property.flag_distressed`, `property.remediate`, `property.record_court_order`, `property.discharge_court_order`, `property.court_directed_sale` and `property.record_sale`, but A34's ids are `M22.distress`, `M22.distressRemediation`, `M22.courtOrder`, `M22.courtOrderDischarge`, `M22.courtDirectedSale` and `M03.saleCompletion`. Reconciliations 6 and 7 match approvals by these non-existent ids.
findings.fix: Pick one owner for the P1 exit. Either (a) A34 keeps rows 20-22 and A48 only reacts to `exit_approved`: drop the three A48 rows, `WD_P2_VOTE_REQUIRED` and `POST /vehicles/{id}/exit/*`; or (b) add an eighth Specify reconciliation that changes A34 rows 20-22 to A48's approval rows and adds the A48 SVCA pairs to A34's allow-list. Replace every `property.*` id with A34's `M22.*` / `M03.saleCompletion` ids throughout (§0 rec 6 and 7, §3, the challenges).

findings.issue: The shortfall variant can never reach `wound_down`. A34 row 25 guards `sold -> wound_down` with `waterfall_paid from A40` (`PROP_WIND_DOWN_BEFORE_WATERFALL`). In a shortfall A40 refuses to create the exit run (`DST_WATERFALL_SHORTFALL`), so no run ever closes and `waterfall_paid` is never true. A48's `winddown.waterfall_shortfall_accept` closes only its own checklist step. The pass criterion 'a shortfall variant reaches wound_down only through the 6E acceptance' and the Bay Road challenge cannot both pass without editing A34 or A40, and neither edit is among the seven reconciliations.
findings.fix: Add a reconciliation. Either A34's `waterfall_paid` fact also accepts a closed `winddown.waterfall_shortfall_accept` approval id from A48, or A40 accepts a zero-line `kind = exit` run bound to that approval id and emits `closed`. Name the owner's test that is re-run.

findings.issue: Marketplace suspend freezes investors' money platform-wide, which nothing asks for. The platform `Halt` opened by `platform.marketplace_suspend` has cause `kill_switch` and scope `all`. A19's G10 maps `all` to every action kind, including distribution lines and withdrawals, and A40 treats scope `all` as a pause source. So engaging marketplace suspend stops every distribution and every AUD withdrawal on the platform. The product map defines marketplace suspend as 'nothing is offered, sold or traded' (ADM-34, D17), and the spec's own inflow-freeze rule keeps outflows running. R1 and R6 also depend on this side effect for their 'distribution hold' instead of an explicit action.
findings.fix: Seed the `kill_switch` cause and the platform halt with scope `resale_board` + `new_offers`. Make the distribution hold in R1 and R6 an explicit, separately approved action: for example a platform or per-vehicle `halt.open` with scope `distributions` under its own SGL+R id. Add a pass criterion: with marketplace suspend engaged, a withdrawal and a distribution payout still complete.

findings.issue: The spec's action codes and ratification duplicate and contradict A14's seeded SGL+R rows. A14 already seeds `treasury.inflow_freeze` (CCO or RE board delegate -> Ratification, 2 h), `offering.halt` (the J21 step 2 time-boxed halt, CCO -> board delegate, 24 h, system trigger allowed) and `resale.halt` (MKTO or SVCA on trigger -> CCO, 2 h, system_trigger_allowed). A48 adds `halt.open`, `kill_switch.inflow_freeze` and `kill_switch.marketplace_suspend` with different ratifier sets, and reconciliation 4 does not retire or alias A14's rows. The result is two ways to 'engage' the same control, one of which A21's `setFlag` refuses. A14 also requires system-triggered protective acts (a Sev1 recon break halting resale) to be SGL+R requests with the SVCA as actor and a human ratifier within 2 h. A48 gives system-cause halts `approval_id` null and `ratification_state` n/a, so a system halt is never ratified (G13).
findings.fix: In reconciliation 4, state the mapping explicitly. Either reuse A14's codes (`treasury.inflow_freeze`, `offering.halt` / `resale.halt`) and add only the missing marketplace-suspend row, or rename A14's rows to A48's codes in A03 with A14's seed tests re-run. State that system-cause halts open under A14's system-triggered SGL+R row (SVCA actor, `trigger_ref` = source event) and are ratified by a human within 2 h like every other protective act. Update the G13 criterion and the timer pass criterion.

findings.issue: A challenge expects the wrong refusal. In 'The switch that cannot be put back by the wrong hands', the two token restore attempts at 09:01 are expected to fail with A21's `self_subject`. But `agents.traffic` has been off since 09:00, and the same challenge (and A12) say the gateway refuses every token call from then on with `423 AGENTS_PAUSED` `tier: platform`, before A21 is reached. Hidden oracle tests written from this text would fail a correct build or push the builder to exempt restore calls from the switch.
findings.fix: Expect `423 AGENTS_PAUSED` (`tier: platform`) for the token attempts while the switch is off. Test `self_subject` separately: a token-drafted `kill_switch.release` created before the engage, then submitted and approved by humans, must be refused by `setFlag` because its maker principal is a token. This matches A21's own 'Four doors' case (d).

findings.issue: Reconciliation 6 describes an A36 interface that no longer exists. A36 already models A48's stops as `offering_hold` rows (kinds `halt` and `kill_switch`, with `source_ref`) through `setHold`/`releaseHold`. Its allow-list gives A48 `hold` and `release`, and it states that holds are not transitions and never run the human-only `live -> suspended`. A48 instead calls A36's 'internal `halt` transition', adds a `lift` direction, asks A36 to record pause reasons, and falls back to `offer.resume`. Applying reconciliation 6 would change A36 for no reason, and the §2 and §3 text ('live ones suspended') contradicts A36.
findings.fix: Rewrite reconciliation 6, §2 marketplace suspend and §3 distressed effects to use A36's `setHold({kind: 'halt' | 'kill_switch', source_ref: halt_id | engage approval id})` and `releaseHold` for the same source_ref. One hold per cause gives the multi-cause behaviour without a pause-reason match or an `offer.resume` fallback. Drop the `lift` reconciliation.

findings.issue: A recon halt is created on two paths. A20 calls A19's `openHalt({cause: 'recon_break', source_ref: recon_halt.id})` in its own transaction, and after reconciliation 1 that call forwards to A48's `openSystemHalt`. A48 also mirrors a `Halt` on A20's `recon.halt.set` event. The second path hits `HALT_ALREADY_OPEN` or creates a duplicate row. The outbox-lag and `mirror_check` reasoning assumes only the event path.
findings.fix: Name one creation path: the forwarder in A20's transaction, keyed by `source_ref`. Make `recon.halt.set` an idempotent upsert or verify keyed on `source_ref`, never a second open. Add a test: one recon break produces exactly one `halts` row and one `halt.opened` event.

findings.issue: The automatic legal hold would be refused by A10. §3 places a hold through A10's `POST /v1/audit/holds` as an effect of the court-order transition. A10 marks that route human-only and requires its own `4E` (LEGL -> CCO) approval id. An effector call under the `M22.courtOrder` approval id fails A10's approval match or `audit_human_only`. Releasing the hold on discharge is not specified.
findings.fix: Either add a reconciliation under which A10 accepts the SM-03 court-order or discharge approval id from A48's service principal, or have A48 open A10's `4E` hold request pre-filled for LEGL/CCO and track it as a checklist item. Specify the release on `legal_hold -> operating`.
